title: Pod Salt Fusion Strawberry Kiwi Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Inspired by the Incan goddess, Pacha Mama, Charlie’s Chalk Dust’s legendary e-liquid comes to Pod Salt’s delicious fusion range, bringing its famous blend of fresh, ripe strawberries and the tropical tang of kiwifruit, all layered over a streak of icy cool menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
